description: Get a company's profile in one call, read live from its own website plus official registries: what it does, industry, services, service area, address, phones and emails published by the company (each with the page it came from), social links, and official screening (company registries, contractor licences, US, UK and EU sanctions lists). Use when the user asks who a company is, how to contact it, or wants to research a prospect, supplier or partner. Provide domain (preferred) or name, optional city and country. Businesses only, no personal data. Free with a shared daily quota.

domain.description: Company website or domain, e.g. acme.com

name.description: Company name, used to find the website when no domain is given

name: company_profile
title: Company profile from a website or name
